note: The city is the Chittagong City Corporation (CCC). It is divided into zones (thanas, the police station areas) and 41 wards. Wards are a finer, optional detail inside a zone. A ward that the source places in more than one zone is listed under each of them. Karnaphuli thana lies outside the City Corporation, so it is not listed.

areas.name: Chittagong City Corporation (CCC)
areas.source: The whole city. Businesses that deliver everywhere in the city choose this area. Customers choose their zone (thana) instead. No boundary yet, so matching is by name only.
